text:
marie (docs): opened a focused PR to add nebula-3b to the model catalog. Main items: canary rollout YAML for Console, short migration HOWTO from orion-xl/zephyr-mini, concise bench table, runtime compatibility note, and a tiny QA prompt to detect long-context truncation. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infer-docs/pull/487

chris (ops): putting ops note up-front: recommend including a Console snippet for a 10% canary with a 5-minute ramp, and show a fallback route to orion-xl. also add required RBAC note for Dedicated namespaces.

marie (docs): got it. Drafting canary YAML; dropping here for review:
```yaml
routes:
  - name: nebula-canary
    percent: 10
    model: nebula-3b:v1
    region: us-west-2
    fallback:
      model: orion-xl:stable
      threshold: 0.9
    rollout:
      duration: 5m
      health_check: /healthz
```
please call out that percent is traffic weight, not instance count.

sam (eng): YAML looks fine. tiny nit: change threshold to 0.95 for error-rate fallback. Add a note that canary must run in same GPU class or it will be force-mapped and may fail.

leo (ml): compatibility notes to add: runtime ABI >= 2.4.0 required. quant defaults: ptq4 (recommended), int8-experimental (downgrade perf on some rotary implementations). Also add tip: disable rotary fast-path if users see token-quality regressions with int8.

marie (docs): adding that. For benchmarks, ops asked for A100/A10/T4 numbers — I'll include r/s @512 tokens and p95 per-token latency. Draft numbers (please confirm): A100-80GB: 33 r/s @512 (p95 80ms/token), A10: 19 r/s (p95 140ms/token), T4: 9 r/s (p95 230ms/token).

sam (eng): those match my runs within margin. I'll paste a small CSV later. Also add batch=8 annotation in table header.

asha (qa): QA asks for a deterministic smoke test to catch long-context chopping: propose a python test that sends a 12k-token doc and asserts response contains the known summary token. Putting a tiny example snippet:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
long_doc = "A" * 12000  # synthetic 12k tokens in test harness
resp = client.chat.create(model="nebula-3b", messages=[{"role":"user","content": long_doc}], max_tokens=256)
assert "SUMMARY_TOKEN" in resp.choices[0].message.content
```
note: replace SUMMARY_TOKEN with the canonical marker used by QA harness.

marie (docs): perfect — I'll include a note that the QA harness uses synthetic tokens to avoid PII and that this test should be in the model-card checks. Also including migration CLI snippet for customers pinned to orion-xl: 
```bash
# create model alias pointing to nebula-3b while keeping current pin
redwood models alias create nebula-cost-opt --target nebula-3b:v1 --namespace=team-a
# update route to point 10% to alias
redwood routes update web-api --add-weight nebula-cost-opt=10
```
add a short paragraph explaining aliasing vs pinning semantics.

chris (ops): ops request: add Dedicated note that A10 instance types require GPU driver >= 525.x and CUDA 11.8 for best perf. Otherwise runtime will fallback to CPU and show a warning. Include sample console warning text.

leo (ml): add model-card note: large context handling uses chunked KV caching; sequence ceiling is 16k tokens for nebula-3b, but effective long-context summary quality drops past 12k unless prompt-engineered. Recommend guidance for chunking and stitching.

marie (docs): adding all that. Also found two broken image SVG links from the perf section in earlier draft 9999; fixed to the new assets path. Will include a changelog entry under model-catalog v2.7.1: "nebula-3b added; long-context guidance; canary examples and migration snippets."

sam (eng): quick ask: include a minimal SDK streaming example that shows retry-on-fallback logic. Drafting:```python
from redwood import Client, ClientFallbackError
client = Client()
try:
    for evt in client.chat.stream(model="nebula-3b", messages=[{"role":"user","content":"Explain X"}], max_tokens=256):
        if evt.type == "delta":
            print(evt.delta, end="")
except ClientFallbackError as e:
    # log, then retry with smaller model
    client.chat.create(model="orion-xl", messages=[{"role":"user","content":"Explain X"}], max_tokens=256)
```

asha (qa): once merged QA will add the smoke test to CI and flag any regressions. please ensure the PR links to the CI job.

docs-bot: marie updated the PR and pushed final fixes: bench table with batch=8, canary YAML, CLI alias example, runtime compatibility line, quant notes, QA smoke test snippet, and fixed asset links.

marie (docs): thanks everyone. merging in ~20m if no objections. leaving notes for release: coordinate with eng-release so model-catalog v2.7.1 goes out with a short support email for Dedicated customers. :thumbsup:

chris (ops): approved from ops. Will email infra to check A10 driver rollout next week.

leo (ml): approved for ML compatibility.

sam (eng): ACK. pasting perf CSV in PR comments now.

marie (docs): merging now. :sparkles:
